answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Fingerprinting. Each identity’s actions are hashed into an epoch vector; enrolment requires vector correlation above a threshold with the same identity’s prior-epoch vector. New identities start at a wharf tier with capped influence until three consistent epochs pass. Mismatched or reset behaviour drops the identity to lagoon status, halving its reach. To sustain N sybils, an attacker must pay N times the cost of maintaining coherent, correlated behaviour across epochs, plus the garden of seed actions needed to build each history.
